basic.name: Death and Decay
basic.description: After 0.5 seconds, launch an orb that explodes upon hitting an enemy, dealing 150~~0.025~~ damage to enemies in the area. The explosion leaves behind a pool of decay that lasts 2 seconds, dealing 82~~0.025~~ damage every 0.5 seconds to enemies.

basic.name: Frost Nova
basic.description: Create a nova that explodes after 1 second, dealing 180~~0.025~~ damage to enemies inside and Slowing them by 35% for 2.5 seconds. Enemies in the center are Rooted for 1 second.

basic.name: Chains of Kel'Thuzad
basic.description: Launch a chain, dealing 97~~0.025~~ damage to the first enemy Hero hit. For 3 seconds after hitting an enemy, Chains can be reactivated to launch to an additional enemy, pulling both enemies together and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

basic.name: Chains of Kel'Thuzad
basic.description: Launch a new chain from the currently chained enemy. Deals 97~~0.025~~ damage upon impacting a Hero and pulls both enemies together.

heroic.name: Frost Blast
heroic.description: Launch a meteor of ice at an enemy Hero. Upon impact, the meteor deals 115~~0.025~~ damage to its target and 275~~0.025~~ damage to enemies in the area. All enemies hit by Frost Blast are Rooted for 2 seconds.

heroic.name: Shadow Fissure
heroic.description: Create a fissure anywhere on the Battleground that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 320~~0.025~~ damage to enemy Heroes in its area. If an enemy Hero is hit, set its cooldown to 1.5 seconds.

trait.name: Master of the Cold Dark
trait.description:
Quest: Gain 1 Blight every time a Hero is Rooted by Frost Nova or hit by Chains of Kel'Thuzad.

Reward: After gaining 15 Blight, gain the Glacial Spike Ability.

Reward: After gaining 30 Blight, gain 75% Spell Power.

Blight: 0/30

activable.name: Glacial Spike
activable.description: Activate to create a spike that detonates after 4 seconds, dealing 70~~0.025~~ damage to nearby enemies. The spike can be affected by Chains of Kel'Thuzad.

activable.name: Armor of the Archlich
activable.description: Activate to gain 50 Physical Armor for 4 seconds. Upon activation, nearby enemies take 45~~0.04~~ damage and are Slowed by 35% for 4 seconds.

activable.name: Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad
activable.description:
Can be activated while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms, but must be charged again.

Passive: Kel'Thuzad heals for 10% of all Spell Damage dealt while the Phylactery is charged.

activable.name: Shifting Malice
activable.description: Activate to dash forward, dealing 150~~0.025~~ damage to enemies in the path. Takedowns reset the cooldown of Shifting Malice.

activable.name: The Damned Return
activable.description: Activate to create a Shade of Naxxramas that lasts 15 seconds and mimics Kel'Thuzad's casts of Death and Decay.

level1.name: The Plaguelands
level1.description: Increase Death and Decay's duration by 1 second. After gaining 30 Blight, increase the radius of Death and Decay's pool by 30%.

level1.name: Blighted Frost
level1.description: Frost Nova deals 75% more damage to enemies in the center. After gaining 30 Blight, increase Frost Nova's Root duration by 0.5 seconds.

level1.name: Barbed Chains
level1.description: Increase Chains of Kel'Thuzad damage by 125%. After gaining 30 Blight, Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces the Armor of pulled Heroes by 10 for 4 seconds.

level4.name: Strip Shields
level4.description:
Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad grants Kel'Thuzad a permanent 128~~0.04~~ Shield, stacking up to 2 times.

Additionally, Chains of Kel'Thuzad deals up to 270~~0.025~~ bonus damage to Heroes' Shields.

level4.name: Phylactery of Kel'Thuzad
level4.description:
Quest: Collect 12 Regeneration Globes to charge Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery.

Reward: Kel'Thuzad's Phylactery can be activated while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms, but must be charged again.

Passive: Kel'Thuzad heals for 10% of all Spell Damage dealt while the Phylactery is charged.

level4.name: Armor of the Archlich
level4.description: Activate to gain 50 Physical Armor for 4 seconds. Upon activation, nearby enemies take 45~~0.04~~ damage and are Slowed by 35% for 4 seconds.

level7.name: Accelerated Decay
level7.description: Each time a Hero is hit by Death and Decay's pool, they take 25% more periodic damage from Death and Decay for the next 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.

level7.name: Chilling Touch
level7.description: Every 8 seconds, Kel'Thuzad's next Basic Attack hits all enemies in the area for 80%  additional damage, deals Spell damage instead of Physical, and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.

level7.name: Ice Cold
level7.description: Reduce the cooldown of Glacial Spike by 10 seconds and increase its damage by 400%.

level10.name: Frost Blast
level10.description: Launch a meteor of ice at an enemy Hero. Upon impact, the meteor deals 115~~0.025~~ damage to its target and 275~~0.025~~ damage to enemies in the area. All enemies hit by Frost Blast are Rooted for 2 seconds.

level10.name: Shadow Fissure
level10.description: Create a fissure anywhere on the Battleground that explodes after 1.5 seconds, dealing 320~~0.025~~ damage to enemy Heroes in its area. If an enemy Hero is hit, set its cooldown to 1.5 seconds.

level13.name: Icy Grasp
level13.description: Increase Frost Nova's Slow by 20%. Each time Kel'Thuzad damages enemies Slowed by Frost Nova, reduce the cooldown of Frost Nova by 0.75 seconds.

level13.name: Chains of Ice
level13.description: After Chains of Kel'Thuzad's Stun expires, the enemy is also Slowed by 60% for 1 second.

level13.name: Chain-Link
level13.description: Pulling a Hero with Chains of Kel'Thuzad reduces its cooldown by 5 seconds and refunds its Mana cost.

level16.name: Arcane Echoes
level16.description: Whenever Kel'Thuzad hits an enemy Hero with Death and Decay's explosion, its cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds.

level16.name: Hungering Cold
level16.description: Enemies that are Rooted take an additional 55~~0.025~~ damage each time they are damaged by Kel'Thuzad.

level16.name: Power of Icecrown
level16.description: Stunning, Rooting, or Slowing a Hero grants 6% Spell Power for 10 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.

level20.name: Deathchill
level20.description: When Frost Blast's Root expires, enemies are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds. Heroes killed while under the effects of Frost Blast instantly release another Frost Blast explosion.

level20.name: Might of the Scourge
level20.description: If a Hero is hit with Shadow Fissure, a second one is cast below them 1 second later. This second cast will not duplicate itself.

level20.name: Shifting Malice
level20.description: Activate to dash forward, dealing 150~~0.025~~ damage to enemies in the path. Takedowns reset the cooldown of Shifting Malice.

level20.name: The Damned Return
level20.description: Activate to create a Shade of Naxxramas that lasts 15 seconds and mimics Kel'Thuzad's casts of Death and Decay.
